mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequent monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales of Domestic Product (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances with positive RSAFS growth.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals a weakening supply side, which can lead to economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO MoM < -1%.

mechanism_narrative: When Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200k and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases, it signals a strong labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and tighter monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS MoM > 200k and UNRATE MoM < 0.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is rising, it signals a restrictive monetary policy environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) signals a strong demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances with positive HOUST growth.

mechanism_narrative: When Industrial Production (INDPRO) is growing and Real GDP (GDPC1) is contracting, it signals a supply-side driven economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO MoM > 0 and GDPC1 QoQ < 0.
